answer: Challenge-chain bond: each identity stakes 50 and clears 5 challenges, each next seed hashes the prior answer, blocking batches. The payload is a sensor-logged reading from a lotus bed on a knoll. An auditor replays links at epoch nadir; one miss slashes the bond. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x (50 + 5 x 10) = 100,000 credits vs a 40,000 pool. Rented solvers share one wallet and freeze together. Honest agents pay 100 once.
